verdict.rationale: The evidence points to a public GitHub repository for the Hatchet engine (hatchet-dev/hatchet), and the docs describe running your own instance of the control plane. Together these suggest the source is readable and runnable by users. However, nothing in the pack states which license the code is under or confirms that it is an OSI-approved open license, so the 'open license' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit license statement (e.g., MIT/Apache) and confirmation that the full control plane source, not just the SDKs, is published under it.
